name: set_timer
description: Start a timer. When it ends, the app rings, shows a card and you say the label aloud. Works when the app is in the background too.

minutes.description: Duration in minutes, fractions allowed (0.5 is 30 seconds).

label.description: What it is for, in the user's language, e.g. "pasta". Empty if not said.

name: set_alarm
description: Set an alarm for a time of day (local time). It rings at the next occurrence of that time.

label.description: What it is for, in the user's language. Empty if not said.

name: schedule_command
description: Run a home command later, e.g. "turn off all the lights in 5 hours" or "in 4 hours set the floor back to 23". Do the part for now right away with the home tools and schedule only the later part. The command runs without this conversation, so make it self-contained: device names, rooms and exact values, never "back" or "it". At that time you carry it out silently and the panel shows what you did. It runs only while the app is open. For reminders use set_timer or set_alarm.

command.description: The command in the user's language, e.g. "Set the warm floor in the living room to 23 degrees".

minutes.description: In how many minutes. 0 when time is given.

time.description: 24-hour local time HH:mm, the next occurrence. Empty when minutes is given.

name: list_timers
description: List the timers, alarms and scheduled commands that are set, with their ids and when they ring or run.

name: cancel_timer
description: Cancel a timer, alarm or scheduled command by its id from list_timers, or all of them with id "all".
